page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head above the text; page number at top right; signature at foot left; in the right margin, a group of small notes beside the second half of the column.

main_text.l: Atq; hunc librum vult esse partem suæ revo-
cationis, si per Bullam ad eam adigatur. Ubi
autem Bullam accepit, contemptim de ea
loquens, Venit tandem, inquit, bulla ista

l.i: Romana, per Eccium allata: de qua nostri scribunt ad
Principem plura: ego eam contemno, & jam inva-
do tanquàm impiam & mendacem, omnibus a
modis Eccianam. Vides in ea damnari Christum ipsum:
deinde nihil afferri causæ: tandem me vocari, non
ad audientiam, sed ad palinodiam: ut scias,
eos plenos esse furore, cæcitate, & amentiâ, qui nihil
videant, neque cogitent: agam tamen adhuc presso
nomine Papæ, tanquam in efficiam, & ementitam
bullam, quanquam credam veram & propriam esse
eorum. O utinam Carolus vir esset: & pro Chri-

main_text.l: ptum edit, in quo Bullam ipsam & Bullæ au-
iam publicat omnium articulorum à Papa
damnatorum: à Pontifice iterum ad Conci-
stum: & cum audiret libros suos ab Hiero-
Electore, esse incensos: ipse x. Decembris,
convocato omni cœtu scholastico, V Vit-
Legantur omnia Tom. 2. operum. Lat. Jenen.

marginalia.note: Legantur omnia Tom. 2. operum. Lat. Jenen.

page.notes: Right margin notes: "Legantur omnia / Tom. 2. operum. / Lat. Jenen." Some marginal ink smudges and a stain near the foot of the column; the word "Vit-" is hyphenated at the line end. Passage in italics is Luther's quoted speech. Text partly damaged by show-through and a stain at lines near "esse incensos" and "omni", readings there are doubtful. The paragraph beginning "Deinde" has the margin note placed at its end.
